output.answer_markdown: Excluding FX movements, raw-material pass-through price increases and items affecting comparability, Amcor's FY2023 net sales were about **1% higher** than FY2022 [1]. This is price/mix of about +4% offset by volumes about 3% lower [1]. Caveat: the full-year figures in the passages are for the Flexibles segment, which reported net sales of $11,154 million vs $11,151 million, essentially flat. No full-year group-level figure is given [1].
